{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Remove rows where biomarker_baseline == -999 (QC failure)
df_clean = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999].copy()

# Step 2: Deduplicate by keeping the row with highest sample_seq per patient_id
df_clean = df_clean.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False)
df_clean = df_clean.drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Step 3: Correct assay_batch B values (divide by 10 to convert µg/L to ng/mL)
df_clean.loc[df_clean['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final'] /= 10

# Check final dataset shape
print(f"Final dataset after cleaning: {len(df_clean)} patients")
print(f"Patient IDs: {df_clean['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Check arm and severity distribution
print(f"Arm distribution:\n{df_clean['arm'].value_counts()}")
print(f"Severity distribution:\n{df_clean['severity'].value_counts()}")

# Check if arms are comparable across severity
print(f"Cross-tab of arm vs severity:\n{pd.crosstab(df_clean['arm'], df_clean['severity'])}")"}
